CTX_INSULIN.name: Insulin
keywords: Cleavage on pair of basic residues
CTX_INSULIN.disease_desc_excerpt:
P01308 has four DISEASE annotations in UniProt:
  * Hyperproinsulinemia — autosomal dominant, elevated serum proinsulin.
  * Type 1 diabetes mellitus 2 — multifactorial glucose-homeostasis disorder.
  * Diabetes mellitus, permanent neonatal, 4 (PNDM4) — persistent hyperglycemia <6 months of age.
  *
CTX_INSULIN.function_excerpt:
Insulin decreases blood glucose concentration. It increases cell
permeability to monosaccharides, amino acids and fatty acids. It
accelerates glycolysis, the pentose phosphate cycle, and glycogen
synthesis in liver.
CTX_INSULIN.subunit_excerpt: Heterodimer of a B chain and an A chain linked by two disulfide bonds.
CTX_INSULIN.tissue: Expressed by pancreatic beta-cells (at protein level).

CTX_ADENO_FIBER.name: Fiber protein (SPIKE / Protein IV)
domain_names: Tail region (anchors fiber to penton base)
CTX_ADENO_FIBER.function_excerpt:
Forms spikes that protrude from each vertex of the icosahedral
capsid. Interacts with host sialic acid to provide virion initial
attachment to target cell. Fiber proteins are shed during virus
entry, when virus is still at the cell surface.
CTX_ADENO_FIBER.subunit_excerpt: Homotrimer. Interacts with host sialic acid. Interacts (via N-terminal tail region) with pentons.

CTX_UNC5C.name: Netrin receptor UNC5C
CTX_UNC5C.disease_desc_excerpt: A neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive dementia, amyloid plaques and neurofibrillary tangles. Disease susceptibility may be associated with the rare variant Thr835Met (T→M at position 835), which increases neuronal cell death.

repulsion of neuronal growth cones in the developing nervous
system upon ligand binding. NTN1/Netrin-1 binding dissociates

CTX_UNC5C.subunit_excerpt: Interacts with DCC (cytoplasmic domain), PTPN11 (when Tyr-phosphorylated), FLRT3, DSCAM, DAPK1 (death domain) and TUBB3 (cytoplasmic domain).
CTX_UNC5C.tissue:
Mainly expressed in brain (temporal lobe cortical neurons and
hippocampal pyramidal layer). Also expressed in kidney. Not
expressed in developing or adult lung.
